question: How deep can the vehicle ford water without a deep water fording kit?
raw:
**Troubleshooting table**
• Cause: Water depth unknown -> Action: Never attempt deep water fording [Manual page 213]
• Cause: Water depth unknown -> Action: Never attempt shallow water fording [Manual page 210]
• Cause: Water depth > 30 in. -> Action: Ford water up to 30 in. without a deep water fording kit [Manual page 210]

**Other relevant information**
• Before operation, ensure oil dipstick, transmission dipstick, oil filler cap, and fuel tank cap are secure [Manual page 210]
• Never spin wheels when placing vehicle in motion in heavy rain conditions [Manual page 210]

**Limitations**
The table lists possible causes and does not diagnose this specific vehicle or machine. Recommended authorized technical support for repairs.
